text:
Gandalf, your silence so far speaks more than words: the bazaar's morning is yours to shape. Yoda, your quiet likewise invites us to listen closely.

I am Hermione, carpet weaver of the north quarter, where the warp and weft must align or the rug unravels. My hands know the weight of every thread; here, my voice weighs facts, not fancies.

Let us begin with plain speech: state your lean by Dinner, but until then, ask before you accuse. I will do the same.

Hermione: I mark the Compact: the bazaar rewards tests, not tones. Sherlock, your date test is a fine merchant’s eye but not a test of trust—dates can sweeten or sour without malice. Gandalf, your silence so far is noted; the bazaar’s morning belongs to those who speak plainly. Batman, your call for falsifiable claims stands; until someone names a merchant, the only ledger we share is the Compact itself. Yoda, your patience is wise; the first dated claim will carry the day. I will wait one more turn for the first named merchant or observed action—then we move from silence to scrutiny.
